title: Input Read Under Unary Reinterpretation
statement: Let $x$ be a binary input and $c$ a configuration on $x$. The symbol read from the configuration reinterpreted on the all-ones input of length $|x|$ equals the symbol read from $c$ with each present symbol replaced by $1$; a blank read remains blank.
replaced: For every configuration $d$ on an input $x$, the input symbol read by the reinterpretation of $d$ over the all-ones word of length $|x|$ equals the symbol read by $d$ with every non-blank bit replaced by $1$.
